description: Bug fixes and UI polish - Parlay submission, bet slip UX, visual consistency, and display improvements

userStories.title: Fix Parlay Submission Edge Function Error
userStories.description: As a player, I want to submit parlays without getting a 'function not found' error so that I can place multi-leg bets.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify which Edge Function is being called for parlay submissions
Ensure the function exists and is deployed (likely submit_bet or a missing submit_parlay)
Parlay submissions complete successfully without NOT_FOUND error
Error message does not appear twice (fix duplicate error handling)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed: The issue was that submit_bet Edge Function expects side as 'a' or 'b', but the Swift code was passing the display name (e.g., 'Lakers -3.5'). Added sideIndicator field to BetSlipSelection and BetSlipItem to track the normalized side value, and updated BetConfirmationSheet to pass sideIndicator to the server.

userStories.title: Auto-close Bet Slip When Cleared
userStories.description: As a player, I want the bet slip to automatically close when I clear all selections so that I don't have to manually dismiss an empty slip.
acceptanceCriteria: When 'Clear All' is tapped on bet slip, automatically dismiss the sheet after clearing
Only auto-dismiss when all items are cleared (not when removing individual items)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added dismiss() call after betSlipManager.clearAll() in the Clear All button action in BetSlipSheet.swift.

userStories.title: Prevent Conflicting Selections in Parlays
userStories.description: As a player, I want the app to prevent me from creating a parlay with conflicting selections (opposite sides of the same event) so that I don't accidentally place an impossible bet.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect when bet slip contains opposite sides of the same market (e.g., Hawks ML and Rockets ML)
Allow conflicting selections as separate single bets (current behavior, keep as-is)
Disable/hide parlay option when conflicting selections exist in the bet slip
Show message explaining why parlay is unavailable (e.g., 'Parlay unavailable: conflicting selections on same game')
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added hasConflictingSelections property to BetSlipManager that detects same-market or same-event+marketType conflicts. Parlay button is disabled and warning message shown when conflicts exist. Auto-switches to singles mode if user adds conflicting selection while in parlay mode.

userStories.title: Show Team Name with Spread on Game Detail
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the team name next to the spread value so that I can clearly understand which team is favored.
acceptanceCriteria: Game detail screen shows team name with spread (e.g., 'OKC -6.5' instead of just '-6.5')
Format: '[Team] [spread]' for both sides (e.g., 'OKC -6.5' and 'HOU +6.5')
Applies to spread market display in EventDetailView or GameDetailView
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Updated GameDetailView.swift to pass full sideA/sideB values (which already contain team name + spread) instead of stripping the team name with formatSpreadValue(). Applied to both Main Lines section and Market List section.

userStories.title: Improve Market Table Typography Hierarchy
userStories.description: As a player, I want the betting lines to be visually prominent with payouts de-emphasized so that I can quickly scan the key numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: Spread value (e.g., '-3.5') uses current white font style (Theme.textPrimary)
Moneyline value (e.g., '-230') uses current white font style (Theme.textPrimary)
Total value (e.g., 'o228.5') uses current white font style (Theme.textPrimary)
Spread payout odds (e.g., '-118') displayed smaller and grayer underneath the spread line
Total payout odds (e.g., '-110') displayed smaller and grayer underneath the total line
Use Theme.textSecondary or Theme.textMuted and smaller font size for payout odds
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added showOddsAsSecondary parameter to CompactOddsButton. Spread and Total buttons display line value (e.g., '-3.5', 'o220.5') prominently with Theme.textPrimary, and payout odds smaller in Theme.textMuted underneath. Moneyline unchanged since odds ARE the key value.

userStories.title: Use Dark Text on Accent-Colored Buttons
userStories.description: As a user, I want green/accent-colored buttons to have dark text for better readability and visual consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons with Theme.accent background use dark text (e.g., Theme.background or black)
Match the style of the 'ALL' filter button as the reference
Apply consistently across the app (bet slip submit, confirmation buttons, etc.)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Updated all buttons with Theme.accent background to use Theme.background (dark) text instead of .white. Fixed: PlayerClaimView (3 buttons), GradeEventSheet (sport badge, Done button, grade indicator, grade buttons), ImportEventsView (Import button). Other accent buttons in BetSlipSheet and WeeklySettlementView already used correct styling.

userStories.title: Remove Tab Titles in Player View
userStories.description: As a player, I want a cleaner interface without redundant titles since the tab bar already indicates the current section.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove 'Games' title from the top of the Games tab in PlayerMainView
Remove 'Track' title from the top of the Track tab in PlayerMainView
Only affects player view (bookie view unchanged)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Standardize Container Background Colors
userStories.description: As a user, I want consistent container/card colors throughout the app so that the UI feels cohesive.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the gray container color being used on the Players tab (likely default iOS or incorrect Theme color)
Identify the correct container color used on the Dashboard tab (likely Theme.cardBackground)
Update Players list container to use the same color as Dashboard
Audit other screens for inconsistent container colors and fix
Ensure all List/Form sections use .listRowBackground(Theme.cardBackground)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Improve Bet Ticket Display Names
userStories.description: As a bookie or player, I want bet tickets to show meaningful names instead of IDs so that I can quickly understand what the bet is.
acceptanceCriteria: Single bets display the selection name (e.g., 'Lakers ML -150' or 'OKC -6.5 (-110)')
Parlays display leg count and total odds (e.g., '3-leg parlay +450')
Update wherever 'Event [UUID]' or similar is displayed (likely BetsListView, TicketDetailView, TrackView)
Typecheck passes
